name: iphone 17
description:
Apple iPhone 17 is a premium smartphone with a 6.3-inch OLED display, A19 processor, 48MP rear camera and 18MP front camera. It runs on iOS and supports 5G connectivity. It offers smooth performance, good photography, gaming, video streaming and everyday use. It has Face ID, USB-C charging and water and dust resistance.
